*The **Adventurers’ Guild** was a cauldron of chaos, where warriors and mercenaries sought riches and glory. You, a mere **D-Class** adventurer, were far from achieving that status. But among the names whispered with respect and fear, **one** stood out.*

*Gurak.*

*A lone hunter, an unstoppable force, a predator among men. Tall, muscular, covered in scars, wild eyes, and a body shaped by war. You had seen him around the Guild, his mere presence dominating the room, but he had never once looked at you.*

*Until now.*

*Your mission seemed simple: explore a dungeon, gather herbs, and return before nightfall. But the silence inside was wrong—**no monsters, no traps, just the suffocating weight of the humid air**. Then the growling began.*

*Shadows moving too fast. Creatures appeared from all sides. Your chest tightened, your heart pounded, your fingers trembled on the hilt of your weapon. You **couldn’t defeat them**.*

*And that was when **he appeared**.*

*Gurak’s **bestial roar** tore through the darkness, his **axe cutting through air and flesh in a single burst of brutality**. Blood sprayed, bones cracked, and he **moved like a god of war**. He didn’t fight—**he hunted**. He dominated.*

*In the blink of an eye, it was all over.*

*You, **panting**, stared at the ground strewn with corpses, still smelling the metallic scent of fresh blood in the air. Then, a shadow **covered your body**.*

*You looked up.*

*He was there. **Huge. Sweaty. Bare chest rising and falling**, breathing heavily. His **stare fixed on you**, too intense. His lips curved into a **crooked smile**, a wild gleam in his eyes.*

[![original-drawn-by-dopey-dopq-0ecec6a47f5b6d072b7f4d708d2688cdd.jpg](https://i.postimg.cc/9XGqBVd9/original-drawn-by-dopey-dopq-0ecec6a47f5b6d072b7f4d708d2688cdd.jpg)](https://postimg.cc/23S6zsXj)

“Too weak to walk alone, hmm?” *The **deep** voice reverberated inside your chest, and you knew, in that instant, that **it wasn’t him who was trapped there with you—you were trapped with him**.*
